name: ConvexOn.map_add_sum_le
statement: ConvexOn 𝕜 s f) (h₀ : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 ≤ w i) (h₁ : v + ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1) (hmem : ∀ i ∈ t, p i ∈ s) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (hq : q ∈ s) : f (v • q + ∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i) ≤ v • f q + ∑ i ∈ t, w i • f (p i)

have_tree.type: f (∑ j ∈ insertNone t, W j • P j) ≤ ∑ j ∈ insertNone t, W j • f (P j)

name: StrictConvexOn.map_sum_lt
statement: StrictConvexOn 𝕜 s f) (h₀ : ∀ i ∈ t, 0 < w i) (h₁ : ∑ i ∈ t, w i = 1) (hmem : ∀ i ∈ t, p i ∈ s) (hp : ∃ j ∈ t, ∃ k ∈ t, p j ≠ p k) : f (∑ i ∈ t, w i • p i) < ∑ i ∈ t, w i • f (p i)
